role: Renders an EntityBoat: the boat model rotated by its yaw with the post-hit wobble rotation, at the boat texture.
scope_reason: world.conf sets boats = off: boats cannot be placed, so no EntityBoat ever exists and this renderer is never reached, in the oracle too (SPEC 'Unsupported features are world switches').

members.name: boatTextures
members.note: never bound; boats are switched off

members.name: doRender
members.note: unreachable: boats cannot be placed (world.conf boats = off)

notes: The renderer would only matter after the boats switch turns on, which SPEC gates on the native engine having the feature first.
